source_caption:
Grown Ups is a comedy about five childhood friends who reunite after their basketball coach dies. They meet with their families at a lake house for the Fourth of July weekend and spend time remembering their childhood and competing in silly games. The film stars comedians like Adam Sandler and Kevin James.

During the trip, the friends realize how their lives have changed as adults with jobs, marriages, and kids. Through funny situations and friendly rivalry, they learn that friendship and simple moments from childhood are more important than success or busy lifestyles.

source_details.title: Grown Ups
source_details.synopsis: Grown Ups is a 2010 American comedy film starring Adam Sandler, Kevin James, Chris Rock, David Spade, and Rob Schneider. The film was directed by Dennis Dugan, and written by Sandler and Fred Wolf. Salma Hayek, Maria Bello, and Maya Rudolph appear in supporting roles. The film's plot tells the story of five lifelong friends who won their junior high school basketball championship in 1978. They reunite three decades later for a 4th of July weekend after learning about the death of their former coach.
